leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of a Card component's props
Implement a functional React component with typed props to create a reusable Card
Use JSX syntax to construct the basic HTML structure of a Card component
Apply conditional rendering to display optional content sections within the Card
Utilize CSS classes and inline styles to control the visual presentation of the Card
Handle user interactions by implementing click event handlers on Card elements
Define and use component state to manage dynamic content within the Card
Construct nested JSX elements to organize Card content into header, body, and footer sections
Apply TypeScript generics to create flexible prop types for different Card variants
Implement prop validation to ensure required Card content is provided
Use React fragments to return multiple Card elements without unnecessary wrapper divs
Modify component structure to accept and render children elements within the Card body
